description: A dashboard of a Looker, Metabase, Omni, Lightdash, Sigma, Tableau or Power BI connection, read with the user's access to the connection (a Salesforce report has no tabs or charts to read, so add it with addReportDatasheets directly): its tabs, and the charts and filters of the tab tabId names, one of the ids in tabs (else the one the dashboard opens on, a Power BI report's or Sigma workbook's first page). Tableau and Power BI list no charts or filters here: once the tab is added to a report, its charts are listed from its picture for the slides agent to add; a Sigma page lists its charts and tables, and the workbook's controls as its filters. Find the dashboard's id with searchDashboards. Confirm the dashboard and tab with the user, then add it to a report with addReportDatasheets; for another tab, call it again with that tab's id from tabs.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

dashboardId.description: The dashboard to read, by the `id` that `searchDashboards` returns.

id.description: Unique identifier for the connection, from `listConnections`, which also returns its `type`.

type.description: The type of connection, as `type` in `listConnections`: the BI tool it connects to. Only Looker, Metabase, Omni, Lightdash, Sigma, Tableau and Power BI (`PowerBI`) connections have dashboards.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

tabId.description: The dashboard tab to read, by its `id` from the `tabs` that `getDashboard` returns: a Looker, Metabase or Lightdash tab, a Tableau view, a Power BI page or a Sigma page. If omitted, the dashboard's first tab is used, or the whole dashboard when it has no tabs, as on Omni. A tab the dashboard doesn't have returns a 404 error.

name: getDashboard
title: Get dashboard
